nativeBaseline.reference: native file input with a native type=button file acquisition/drop action and file list

library: Preserve native file acquisition and accessible selected-file state; use a native button as the non-drag action.

Treat the owned native input FileList as authoritative for chooser, drop, native form submission and reset. Report an empty selection only when an accepted reset clears actual files; do not synthesize native change on reset.
Respect canceled acquisition, native disabled state and single/multiple selection; isolate nested roots and release listeners.
consumer: Author names, accepted-file guidance and list content; own network upload, progress and retries.

notes: #1285 repaired keyboard activation and Elements input parity.
Native button semantics, disabled and drop constraints still need review.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.

Native button migration: React/Vue dropzone renders button; Angular directive and Elements authored hook require button type=button. Native file input accepts only the first file from a multi-file drop unless multiple is enabled. accept remains advisory; consumer validates file type/size and owns upload policy.
Automated tests are not manual AT acceptance; authored native Web drop/list behavior remains consumer-owned.
